value: How a crossing was decided. Banding is in `worldgen.water_crossings`; this records the judgement applied on top of it.
None. Acceptance rule (world 00-core): all eight major cities stay connected; legs may be flood-damaged, bridged or ferried but never absent.

The deepest crossing anywhere in the province measures 1.48 m and the deepest on the major network 1.25 m. Nothing here is too deep to wade. Span decides. A legal or cultural reason can decide over span.

A ferry-band crossing (span >= 70 m) becomes a ferry only where the catalogue already gives it a reason: a household lives there, has a motive to run a boat and would lose income if the crossing were free. Three of the five ferry-band crossings on the major network qualify, in three clusters; the other two are the same water as their cluster and are served by the same stage.

A ford-band crossing (span < 20 m) is left as a ford. 41 of the 52 major-network crossings are these. They are wadeable, they read as a road going through shallow water. Morrowind's own roads do exactly this. They are not defects and they need no structure.

A span-band crossing (20-70 m) is a deck on posts, built by `compile_route_structures` from the families it already ships (the marsh boardwalk on its own posts, the timber trestle). 6 on the major network, 9 on tracks. Not ferries: a boat that crosses 30 m of knee-deep water is a joke. The pieces to bridge it exist.
